title: About Connector Seed-Bank Wall
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 320 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @100o111: Cropped face from stock photo titled “woman smashing laptop with hammer.” Made out... and Daniel Avery - Dream Shoegaze Special | RA Greenhouse Sessions, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Connector Seed-Bank Wall: Connector seed-bank wall, scanned archive object composition with frontal gallery-plate grammar: one small raised square anodized panel floats above center in a severe warm off-white wall field, grounded by a low gray floor band. The panel is built from black horizontal connector sockets; omissions imply a cropped f... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against raised square connector panel, dense upper-right socket canopy, and long bottom floor/baseboard shadow seam.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
